Real mature skin texture, believable fingers, warm ochre wall and golden sunlight, rich tactile sweater fabric. Copy EXACTLY headline 'DEINE LEBENSMITTE. DEIN MOMENT.' on TWO CENTERED lines, small white clean bold sans serif. Below it centered white regular subline 'Entdecke, was jetzt für dich zählt.' No other floating text, no icon, no CTA, no website footer. IMPORTANT: layout must survive center 4:5 crop. Text around 26%-34% of total height, hands and full jar within 40%-76%. feedSafeZone: Internal design margin: headline/subline at least 108px from left/right/top on 1080x1350 Feed canvas. Crop positioned per motif so text has clear breathing room; full jar retained. This is a layout standard, not a claimed universal Meta placement specification.
